debounce_s.source: probe P4 (docs/probes/S3a-P4.md): the shortest measured press period is P9b p10 1.61 s = 3.2 samples at 2 Hz, so an in-cycle idle run can be ONE sample; the debounce must keep one-sample idle runs, i.e. stay below one sample (0.5 s): 0.25 s = half a sample

p_min.source: probe P4 (docs/probes/S3a-P4.md): 0.8 x the smallest measured p10 period (P9b 1.61 s; P9a 1.77 s) = 1.288 s, above the 1.0 s Nyquist period at 2 Hz; the ASSUMED P14a-d priors (twin/dynamics.json sweep lo 2.0 s) lie above it
